title: SpaceX $40B Apollo-Led Loan to Buy Nvidia Chips, Nvidia Near $6 Trillion
summary: Gotrade News - SpaceX (SPCX) is seeking $40 billion in financing led by Apollo Global Management to buy Nvidia AI chips, the Financial Times reported on
body_markdown:
The deal comes a few months after Musk took SpaceX public in June with an $86 billion[initial public offering](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/what-is-an-ipo/) , per Reuters. SpaceX shares fell 1% in extended trading after the report, while Nvidia rose 0.5%.


Deal term (per FT, via Reuters)

$40 billion

2027

Nvidia AI chips


## Apollo Global (APO) to Lead and Place the $40B Debt


Apollo is expected to lead the deal and help place the debt with a broad range of investors, with bond fund Pimco among a small group of lenders in talks to provide financing, according to[Reuters](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/spacex-seeks-40-billion-to-buy-nvidia-chips-ft-reports-4935381) .


The role extends Apollo's push into AI infrastructure lending: in August, Nvidia partnered with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR on financing platforms designed to mobilize more than $500 billion for AI infrastructure projects, the report added.


For[Apollo Global Management (APO)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/apo/) , the mandate lands in a market where demand for capital is rising: Reuters cited a Morgan Stanley estimate that AI infrastructure will require $1.5 trillion in external financing by 2028.


## Nvidia (NVDA): About 4% From a $6 Trillion Market Cap


Per[The Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/10/06/nvidia-is-about-4-from-becoming-the-first-usd6-trillion-company-history-says-the-milestone-itself-tells-you-little/) , Nvidia notched[a fresh record close](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-hits-a-record-as-fed-hike-bets-fade/) on Oct. 5, leaving its market value at roughly $5.8 trillion, about 4% from the $6 trillion mark. The company first crossed $4 trillion on July 9, 2025, and $5 trillion on Oct. 29, 2025, the outlet noted.


The rally rests on fundamentals the chipmaker reported in August. According to The Motley Fool, fiscal second-quarter revenue rose 106% year over year to $96.2 billion and adjusted EPS grew 120% to $2.22, while management guided fiscal third-quarter revenue of around $108 billion, plus or minus 2%.


The SpaceX financing is so far a press report citing people familiar with the matter, and the transaction is not expected to close until 2027, per Reuters.
